# Attribution and change notice

Vendored from [sinhala-soft/sinhala-text-converters](https://github.com/sinhala-soft/sinhala-text-converters), upstream version 1.0.5, MIT license. Source files were transpiled from TypeScript to browser ES modules by removing TypeScript-only annotations and imports; conversion logic was otherwise retained. No independent linguistic validation is claimed.

The upstream README attributes the conversion algorithms to the Language Technology Research Laboratory, University of Colombo School of Computing (UCSC): https://ucsc.cmb.ac.lk/ltrl/services/feconverter. The package is maintained by Sinhala Soft Foundation.

See LICENSE for the full MIT license text.
